metadata.scenario: A returning customer calls to report a persistent issue with their internet service, stating that the connection has been dropping frequently. Category: Service Complaint. Flags: quality_complaint.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Agnes Rodriguez. I'm calling because I've been having some issues with my internet service. Oh, I'm sorry to hear that, Agnes. Can you tell me more about the issue? Yes, the connection keeps dropping frequently, and it's been really frustrating. I understand how that can be frustrating. How long has this been happening? It's been going on for about a week now, but it seems to be getting worse. I see. Have you noticed if it drops at specific times of the day? Mostly in the evenings, but sometimes during the day too. I rely on it for video calls with my daughter. That must be difficult, especially for staying connected. Yes, exactly. Plus, I enjoy our gardening sessions online. Gardening sounds lovely! We can certainly look into this for you. Thank you. I just don't know what to do to fix it. Have you contacted your internet service provider about this issue? I haven't yet. I thought I should report it here first since it affects my care. That's understandable. We can help coordinate with your provider if needed. That would be great. I just want to ensure I can keep my appointments and stay in touch with family. Absolutely, we'll make sure that gets addressed. Would you like me to assist you with that? Yes, please. That would be really helpful. I can also check if we have any caregivers available to help with social activities in the meantime. That would be nice. I could use more interaction while the internet is down. Perfect. Let me take down your details and I'll follow up regarding the internet and potential caregiver assistance. Thank you, Margaret. I really appreciate your help with this. Of course, Agnes. What's the best way to reach you for updates? You can reach me at my cell, +13165551234. Got it. I'll follow up with you by the end of the day tomorrow. Sounds good. Thanks again, Margaret. You’re welcome, Agnes. Take care and chat soon! Bye! Goodbye!
